tokens.name: page
tokens.usage: The page itself. Plain; most of every screen, email and document is this.

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: App background behind cards. Never behind running text.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards and rows that sit on canvas.

tokens.name: soft
tokens.usage: Quiet fill: table heading bands, neutral tags, the track behind a bar.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Titles and body copy on page, surface and soft.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Detail lines and section labels on page, surface and soft.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Faint marks only (a zero, a disabled icon, 24px+ text). Fails 4.5:1 for small text on page - never body copy.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: The 1px hairline between rows and sections.

tokens.name: outline
tokens.usage: The clear outline round every page-level card.

tokens.name: band
tokens.usage: The dark band at the top and bottom of a letterhead, and dark hero cards. Dark in both themes.

tokens.name: band-ink
tokens.usage: Headline and logo lettering on band.

tokens.name: band-ink-2
tokens.usage: Second headline line and quiet details on band.

tokens.name: frame
tokens.usage: The app frame and sidebar behind the main panel. Dark in both themes.

tokens.name: rainbow-lime
tokens.usage: Rainbow stop 1 (0%). Fills and lettering on band only - too light for text on page.

tokens.name: rainbow-mint
tokens.usage: Rainbow stop 2 (38%).

tokens.name: rainbow-sky
tokens.usage: Rainbow stop 3 (70%).

tokens.name: rainbow-violet
tokens.usage: Rainbow stop 4 (100%).

tokens.name: edge-lime
tokens.usage: Bold edge stop 1: the 1.5px outline on buttons and pills.

tokens.name: edge-mint
tokens.usage: Bold edge stop 2.

tokens.name: edge-sky
tokens.usage: Bold edge stop 3.

tokens.name: edge-violet
tokens.usage: Bold edge stop 4.

tokens.name: deep-lime
tokens.usage: Rainbow lettering on page: stop 1. Deep in light so it reads on white; bright in dark.

tokens.name: deep-mint
tokens.usage: Rainbow lettering on page: stop 2.

tokens.name: deep-sky
tokens.usage: Rainbow lettering on page: stop 3.

tokens.name: deep-violet
tokens.usage: Rainbow lettering on page: stop 4.

tokens.name: waiting-bg
tokens.usage: Soft red tag fill: waiting, overdue, something owed.

tokens.name: waiting-ink
tokens.usage: Text on waiting-bg. Red only ever means action outstanding.

tokens.name: clear-bg
tokens.usage: Soft lime tag fill: clear, done, money in.

tokens.name: clear-ink
tokens.usage: Text on clear-bg.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Solid red for a count of things owed, and destructive actions. Paired with a word, never colour alone.

tokens.name: alert-crimson
tokens.usage: Red edge stop 1: the outline of a card or pill with something waiting.

tokens.name: alert-red
tokens.usage: Red edge stop 2.

tokens.name: alert-coral
tokens.usage: Red edge stop 3.

tokens.name: alert-amber
tokens.usage: Red edge stop 4.

tokens.name: tp-teal
tokens.usage: Two Points Alpenglow, stop 1 (0%). Bright: fills, the 3px rule and lettering on band only.

tokens.name: tp-blue
tokens.usage: Alpenglow stop 2 (38%).

tokens.name: tp-indigo
tokens.usage: Alpenglow stop 3 (70%).

tokens.name: tp-pink
tokens.usage: Alpenglow stop 4 (100%).

tokens.name: tp-deep-teal
tokens.usage: Two Points lettering on page, stop 1. Still light on white (about 2:1): rainbow words are 24px+ and bold, never small text.

tokens.name: tp-deep-blue
tokens.usage: Lettering stop 2. Also the Two Points focus ring and the moving dot on the job-steps line.

tokens.name: tp-deep-indigo
tokens.usage: Lettering stop 3.

tokens.name: tp-deep-pink
tokens.usage: Lettering stop 4, and the end of the brand full stop.

tokens.name: tp-dot-violet
tokens.usage: Start of the brand full stop (violet into tp-deep-pink).

tokens.name: tp-ink
tokens.usage: Two Points text colour (a touch darker than Simple ink).

tokens.name: tp-soft
tokens.usage: Two Points quiet fill: photo placeholders, the contact card, the rescue-kit panel.

tokens.name: tp-tag-bg
tokens.usage: Mint tag fill on the Two Points site, e.g. "Coming soon". Light theme only (the site has no dark mode).

tokens.name: tp-tag-ink
tokens.usage: Text on tp-tag-bg (about 6:1).

tokens.name: tp-field-line
tokens.usage: Form field and size-button borders on the Two Points site.

styles.name: hero
styles.usage: One per page: a website or cover headline.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: The two-line letterhead headline. Line 1 in band-ink, line 2 in band-ink-2.

styles.name: detail
styles.usage: The grey line under a row title, in ink-2.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Button and tag labels. One line, never wrapping.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Small section labels only, uppercase, in ink-2.

styles.name: tp-display
styles.usage: The hero headline, set as clamp(60px, 16.2vw, 172px). Once per site.

styles.name: tp-lead-in
styles.usage: The line above the hero headline, clamp(22px, 3.3vw, 44px).
styles.sample: The number one rule of rope access:

styles.name: tp-section
styles.usage: Section headings, clamp(30px, 4.6vw, 50px). Two tones: a statement in ink, then a quiet part in ink-3 ending in one rainbow word and the full stop.
styles.sample: Multiple trades. One set of ropes.

styles.name: tp-lead
styles.usage: Opening paragraph of a story section.
styles.sample: I started Two Points to do the job properly.

styles.name: tp-card
styles.usage: Card and service titles under a photo.

styles.name: tp-body
styles.usage: Website running text. Detail copy in ink-2 at 15px.
styles.sample: Every job starts with a written safety plan.

styles.name: tp-eyebrow
styles.usage: Small uppercase label above a heading.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Between an icon and its word.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between buttons in a group; inside tags.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Phone page gutter. Top margin equals side margin.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Row padding, top and bottom; card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between sections on a letterhead page (22-26px).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Under a page header, before the first card.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Between major sections and linked cards.

tokens.name: tp-gutter
tokens.usage: Two Points website side gutter (with the safe-area inset).

tokens.name: tp-head
tokens.usage: Height of the sticky top band on the website.

tokens.name: tp-section-gap
tokens.usage: Space above each website section.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons inside cards.

tokens.name: radius-btn
tokens.usage: Desktop buttons: rounded rectangles, 36px tall.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards.

tokens.name: radius-bar
tokens.usage: Docks, bars and dark hero panels.

tokens.name: radius-squircle
tokens.usage: The logo tile and numbered tiles.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Phone buttons, tags, round arrow buttons.

tokens.name: tp-radius-field
tokens.usage: Form fields.

tokens.name: tp-radius-photo
tokens.usage: Photos, product tiles, the rescue-kit panel.

tokens.name: tp-radius-panel
tokens.usage: Big panels: the hero video, the dark Simple panel, the contact card.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: A card at rest. Emails and documents use none.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: A card under the pointer, with a 2px lift. Never an outer ring.

tokens.name: shadow-button
tokens.usage: Buttons and pills at rest.

tokens.name: rainbow
tokens.usage: The signature. Small fills only: a knob, a bar, a numbered tile's number. Lime starts bottom-left.

tokens.name: rainbow-line
tokens.usage: Thin lines: an underline, a 3px top edge, a progress bar.

tokens.name: rainbow-deep
tokens.usage: Rainbow lettering on a white page.

tokens.name: edge
tokens.usage: The 1.5px outline of a button or pill.

tokens.name: edge-mirror
tokens.usage: The partner button in a pair, so the two read as a set.

tokens.name: edge-alert
tokens.usage: The outline of a card or pill with something waiting.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: The 2px ring on round arrow buttons, on white.

tokens.name: marker
tokens.usage: A highlighter sweep behind a few words.

tokens.name: band-base
tokens.usage: Dark hero cards and bars: deep green-black.

tokens.name: button-dark
tokens.usage: Button base in dark mode.

tokens.name: tp-alpenglow
tokens.usage: Two Points signature fill: small dots only (list bullets, the Coming soon dot, a lit step).

tokens.name: tp-alpenglow-line
tokens.usage: The 3px rule under the top band, the photo-reveal edge, the job-steps line, the email rule.

tokens.name: tp-word
tokens.usage: Rainbow lettering on white: one word of a heading, and the name Two Points in running text.

tokens.name: tp-ring
tokens.usage: The 1.5px ring round every Two Points button, the app icon edge and lit step rings.

tokens.name: tp-dot
tokens.usage: The brand full stop after a heading or the name, and the full stop in the email address.

tokens.name: tp-marker
tokens.usage: The Alpenglow highlighter that sweeps in behind a few key values.

meta.source: Built from the Simple Design Language system and the Two Points website code (styles.css, index.html, email-signature.html), Nov 2026.
